name: 62221 · Belleville, IL
findings: ZIP 62221 (Belleville) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62221 (Belleville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 62221 (Belleville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
